issues.title: Publish source, documentation, and verification data to GitHub
issues.description:
User request: transfer the complete current FrameCraft state to [https://github.com/mnnsbstn/framecraft](<https://github.com/mnnsbstn/framecraft>).

Acceptance: preserve existing repository content; organize source, tests, instructions, REA evidence, Linear documentation, and original example data traceably. Exclude build caches, credentials, private machine paths, and third-party reference binaries. Verify remote state/artifacts and link GitHub in Linear.

## Outcome and verification

FrameCraft 0.3.0 published to main: [source revision](<https://github.com/mnnsbstn/framecraft/commit/19297da23cfb5075f2297ef1694ce30c2a99770f>). 55 files containing source, tests, build instructions, documentation, REA evidence, a Linear snapshot, original example projects/videos, and the built app. Existing Git history preserved.

Source/tests/build script match the locally verified state byte for byte (17 passing tests). App ZIP integrity checked; SHA-256 manifest generated. Text evidence checked for credentials and personal machine paths, with paths neutralized. No build caches or third-party reference binaries included. GitHub remote tree confirmed the commit and all 55 files; local working tree clean after pushing.

The subsequent documentation sync records completion of this issue. No new app version or recording was needed for this publication-only step.

issues.title: Complete optional REA analysis capabilities
issues.description:
Optional tooling backlog; not required for the current FrameCraft implementation.

Native decompilation requires a configured provider such as Ghidra, Hopper, or IDA. Also investigate the plist/file error. Configure providers and new REA versions only after provenance/installation review; preserve the existing working setup and verify separately.

issues.title: Evaluate cloud sharing as an optional extension
issues.description:
Idea, not authorized for implementation; current use remains local.

Acceptance before implementation: clarify need, target service, access model, revocation/deletion, and data transfer. No automatic publishing or uploads.

issues.title: Add subtitles
issues.description:
Product proposal, not authorized for implementation.

Acceptance: editable subtitles, timing across edits, appearance, and export; clarify the transcription approach and any data transfer before implementation.

issues.title: Add multi-clip editing and internal cuts
issues.description:
Product proposal, not authorized for implementation.

Acceptance: multiple clips, removing/reordering internal segments, preserving cursor-track and zoom-time alignment; test undo, project format, and export.

issues.title: Add webcam composition
issues.description:
Product proposal, not authorized for implementation.

Acceptance: explicitly authorized camera overlay, position/size, synchronization, and denied/disconnected camera handling; verify privacy and export.

issues.title: Support changing cursor shapes
issues.description:
Product proposal, not authorized for implementation. Currently a custom arrow cursor is always rendered.

Acceptance: correctly capture/reconstruct text, hand, and resize cursors; preserve hotspots and size; avoid duplicate burned-in cursors; keep preview and export consistent.

issues.title: Add region recording
issues.description:
Product proposal, not authorized for implementation.

Acceptance: freely selectable recording region with preview, Retina/monitor boundaries; normalize cursor/click data correctly and hide it outside the region.

issues.title: Add export options for quality, resolution, and GIF
issues.description:
Product proposal, not authorized for implementation.

Acceptance: clear quality/resolution/frame-rate choices with reasonable limits; check file size and compatibility. Offer GIF separately with an appropriate no-audio notice. Preserve existing MP4 protection and cancellation checks.

issues.title: Edit zoom intervals directly in the timeline
issues.description:
Product proposal; currently only controls are available.

Acceptance: drag zoom edges and move time ranges with visible feedback and keyboard support; enforce valid boundaries/overlaps; preserve manual changes when recalculating automatic zooms.

issues.title: Test stability with long recordings and failure cases
issues.description:
Proposed quality-assurance round.

Acceptance: test longer recording/export, persistence of large cursor tracks, memory use, CPU, cancellation, and insufficient storage. Measure rendering/recording rates and modernize deprecated AVFoundation calls as needed. Do not claim performance without measurements.

issues.title: Validate display and multi-monitor recording with cursor coordinates
issues.description:
Full-display recording has not yet been practically tested.

Acceptance: check Retina scaling, different monitor positions, window switching/occlusion, cursor outside the source, moving windows, and click/video timing. Keep the app itself excluded from display recording. Use safe test content.

issues.title: Test system audio and microphone input in practice
issues.description:
Implemented but not yet practically validated.

Acceptance: test system audio alone, microphone alone, and both together; check synchronization, levels, muted export, and denied permissions. Use only explicitly approved test sources; document results and media metadata.

issues.title: Keep screen recording permission reliable across app updates
issues.description:
Open reliability issue, not yet implemented. The current build is ad hoc signed; rebuilds can invalidate macOS permissions.

Acceptance: check permission after updating to 0.3; investigate suitable stable signing; document and confirm the update/recovery process with the user. Change only FrameCraft permissions. Use Developer ID/notarization only when access is actually available and distribution is authorized.

issues.title: Implement smooth camera motion for rapid click sequences
issues.description:
Version 0.3 replaces blending of all active zoom targets with an ordered target sequence. Newer targets replace older ones without returning when later regions end. Joint smoothing of crop width/center over 600 ms preserves continuous position, velocity, and acceleration during retargeting. Bridge gaps of up to 300 ms between intervals; manual zooms have priority.

CameraPath is prepared once per composition and evaluated without state. Four new tests, 17 passed in total. Build, launch, and strict local signature verification succeeded. Existing click-test project opened through the UI and exported as FrameCraft-Sanfte-Zooms.mp4: 10.925 s, Full HD, 30 fps, no audio; multiple frames checked. Very short zooms may ease out beyond their nominal end.

issues.title: Renew screen recording permission and validate a real click test
issues.description:
The existing macOS permission became invalid after an ad hoc rebuild. With explicit user approval, only FrameCraft was removed and the current app added again; local authentication was performed by the user.

Remote UI actions produced no global mouse movement. The user therefore performed start, mouse movement, clicks, and stop directly. Version 0.2 result: 10.925 s, 10 clicks, 590 cursor positions (373 visible), and 6 zooms. Full HD/30 fps MP4 without audio; exact cursor points, inspected frames, and successful project reopening.

Evidence: FrameCraft-Klicktest.framecraft/.mp4. Permission has not yet been retested after rebuilding version 0.3.

issues.title: Add a separate cursor track, smoothing, and click indicators
issues.description:
Original recording without a burned-in cursor. Separate position/visibility data, a custom arrow cursor, 0–250 ms smoothing, size, visibility, and click indicators. Click points remain exact; hide the cursor outside the source and across data gaps. No keyboard recording.

Identical preview/export behavior. Tests cover jitter, exact click points, visibility gaps, older projects, persistence, and cursor pixels. Limitations: fixed arrow shape; cursors embedded in imported videos cannot be smoothed retroactively.

issues.title: Generate automatic zooms from recorded mouse clicks
issues.description:
Capture clicks during recording, normalize against the first video frame, and restrict them to the recording source. Generate automatic 1.8× zooms after stopping; nearby repeated clicks extend one zoom. Preserve manually edited zooms when recalculating.

Live test: 10 real clicks generate 6 automatic zooms; saved intervals reproduce from click data.

issues.title: Save and reopen editable projects
issues.description:
The .framecraft project folder contains the original video and JSON settings. Save with ⌘S, reopen, dirty-state tracking, and input validation. Older projects without cursor tracks remain readable.

Verified: format, trim, zooms, and cursor smoothing/size survive reopening. Keep the entire project folder together for future use.

issues.title: Validate the shared preview/export pipeline and MP4 export
issues.description:
Shared Core Image composition for preview and MP4 export, 30 fps, progress and cancellation. Protect originals/existing targets from overwrites and clean up temporary files on cancellation.

Automated landscape/portrait exports: trimming seconds 1–4 produces 3 seconds at 1920×1080 or 1080×1920; frames decode successfully. Real window recording and demo exported. Configurable export quality/GIF not yet available.

issues.title: Build the editor with import, preview, trimming, and appearance controls
issues.description:
MP4/MOV import, an original six-second demo, playback and scrubbing, and nondestructive start/end trimming. Manual zoom intervals with focus and strength. Formats: 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1; four original gradients, padding, corner radius, and shadow.

UI verified with the demo: import/demo, trimming, focus, background, and format. No multi-clip editing or draggable zoom edges yet.

issues.title: Implement display and window recording
issues.description:
Recording sources via ScreenCaptureKit; window/display selection, start/stop including the menu bar, and exclusion of the app itself from display recording. Watchdogs and finalization through the recording delegate; interrupted files are not imported as completed recordings.

System audio and optional microphone input implemented, with permissions requested only as needed. The silent TextEdit window recording was practically verified; audio and full-display acceptance checks remain separate pending work.

issues.title: Set up the native app, local build environment, and reuse
issues.description:
SwiftPM/SwiftUI app for macOS 15+, ScreenCaptureKit, AVFoundation, and Core Image; no third-party package dependencies. The user completed Xcode licensing/initial setup.

Project-local build/run script and Codex Run action; dist/FrameCraft.app with a local ad hoc signature. App and source project ZIPs, README, and build status. The build script protects active recordings by requiring an orderly quit before relaunch. No public notarization.

issues.title: Inspect the Screen Studio reference read-only with REA
issues.description:
The officially linked Apple Silicon package 4.1.0-5005 was inspected read-only. REA inventoried 4,260 content nodes. Nine ASAR checksum contradictions and an invalid strict app signature were found; the reference app was therefore neither run nor installed.

Independent implementation based on the functional description and Apple APIs; no assets or program components copied. Evidence: docs/Analyse.md, docs/REA-Befunde.json. Static-inspection limitations documented.

issues.title: Set up REA persistently and verify provenance
issues.description:
REA 6.4.0 configured for the local user while reusing the existing configuration. Official sources: [github.com/morluto/rea](<http://github.com/morluto/rea>), [rea.tools](<http://rea.tools>), and npm rea-agents. Package integrity checked against SHA-512; 1,161 files compared. Skill and launcher persist across sessions.

Verified: CLI, MCP identity, 170 tools, 6 prompts, archive test, and static JavaScript test. Limitations: the plist test with the native file probe failed; native decompilation still requires a provider. No unreviewed third-party installation script was executed.

Local evidence: REA-Nutzung.md and REA test/verification files in the output directory.

_translation.note: English translation of the German Linear snapshot. IDs, URLs, technical values, statuses, and source timestamps are preserved. Linear itself remains German; this is not a verbatim export.
